title: Privara Unmask
description:
Privara Unmask is the Android malware sandbox that recovers the C2. Pay only for results. It extracts the command-and-control (C2) servers of Android malware, including servers hidden behind packers, dead-drop resolvers and encrypted strings. Each C2 is checked by a verifier and probed for liveness.

This connector sends the Android package attached to an Artifact or File observable (APK, XAPK, APKM or .apks) to the Unmask API and imports the result:

- an Indicator for each C2 (URL, IPv4, IPv6, domain or host:port pattern) with the MITRE ATT&CK command-and-control phase, its liveness check and whether abuse.ch already lists it
- the Malware family when it is identified, with `indicates` relationships
- optional URL / IP / domain observables linked to the indicators (`based-on`)
- a Note with the outcome, the charge and the link to the job on tajapps.com

Candidates rejected by the verifier are never imported as indicators. Unmask is billed per result (live C2 $25, dead C2 $9, nothing found is free) from a prepaid wallet on tajapps.com, so automatic enrichment is off by default. Sign up at https://tajapps.com/unmask/.
short_description: Privara Unmask, the Android malware sandbox that recovers the C2: import the C2 servers of an APK as indicators. Pay only for results.
